scope: external hubs only; intra-cluster citations are in citation-network.json
countingMethod: Full-text occurrence across each unit's .json + -edges.csv, NOT raw interlocutors-array counts. The array counts undercount badly. Three first-draft claims in the .md were wrong under array-counting and are corrected in its section 5.

heideggerIsFourObjects.claim: Treating 'Heidegger' as one hub hides the cluster's fault line. He is cited as four distinct objects, and which one a unit cites predicts almost everything about it.

FCM (GA 29/30, 1929-30).supplies: the three forms, structural moments, Zeitvertreib, the Grundstimmung claim -- the cluster's ENTIRE boredom content

Being and Time (1927).supplies: Befindlichkeit, angst, das Man, authenticity -- mood's architecture, but almost NO boredom

later technology essays.supplies: Gestell, Bestand, Gelassenheit -- the education strand's frame, with NO boredom at all

1924 Aristotle lectures (GA 18).supplies: pathos, hedone, the Rhetoric rehabilitation -- predates FCM by five years, NO boredom

heideggerIsFourObjects.finding: Three of Heidegger's four cluster-presences contain no boredom analysis. Strand B's 'Heidegger and education' units mostly cite the TECHNOLOGY Heidegger, not the BOREDOM Heidegger -- which is exactly why bor-sec-15/17/19 came back with near-zero boredom content despite their titles. The Heidegger hub is a homonym, not a shared reference point.

blocPartition.claim: The external-hub network is partitioned as cleanly as the internal one -- the same wall, seen from outside.

crossingHubs.Elpidorou: IS the bridge, by self-citation (see citation-network.json).
crossingHubs.Eastwood: 15 units, but reaches Strand A ONLY via bor-sec-04 and bor-sec-05 -- both Elpidorou & Freeman papers. Does not independently bridge the divide; is carried across it by Elpidorou. REINFORCES the sole-bridge finding. (P/anticipatory-application)
crossingHubs.Farmer & Sundberg: 10 units, same pattern: reaches Strand A only via bor-sec-04, and there as the instrument E&F argue CANNOT measure profound boredom.
crossingHubs.Csikszentmihalyi: The genuine exception: 14 units across six of seven strands, with Strand-B (Mansikka) and Strand-F (Haj-Bolouri, Nacke & Lindley) presences INDEPENDENT of Elpidorou. But crosses asymmetrically -- C/D/E cite the operationalizable four-channel model (boredom as measurable quadrant); Mansikka cites him as the CONTRAST case, the flow ideal against which Heideggerian boredom is precisely not to be measured. Same hub, opposite uses. Flow is the one concept both halves hold -- and they hold it for opposite reasons. (P/anticipatory-application)
